labeling_policy: Each query is relevant to all candidate documents in its assigned intent group. Documents in other groups are non-relevant within this benchmark's closed candidate set. This is a small evaluation fixture, not production traffic.

groups.query: Can you estimate when the item I bought will arrive?
candidates: Track the current delivery status of an online order
Check shipment progress for a recent purchase
Find the latest shipping update for my package

groups.query: I cannot sign in because I forgot my login credentials.
candidates: Reset the password for my account
Recover access after forgetting a login password
Change the password associated with my user profile

groups.query: Stop my paid membership from renewing next month.
candidates: Cancel my subscription before the next billing cycle
Terminate the recurring membership payment
Turn off automatic renewal for my subscription

groups.query: Authorize reimbursement for the customer's returned item.
candidates: Approve the customer's refund request
Confirm that a refund should be issued to the customer
Authorize reimbursement for this customer

groups.query: Reject the customer's request to get their money back.
candidates: Deny the customer's refund request
Reject the requested customer refund
Do not authorize reimbursement for this customer

groups.query: How much money is currently available in my checking account?
candidates: Show the current balance of my bank account
Check how much money remains in checking
Retrieve my latest available account balance

groups.query: Show me the latest purchases charged to my credit card.
candidates: List recent credit card transactions
Review the latest charges posted to my card
Display my credit card purchase history

groups.query: Move fifty dollars from my checking account into savings.
candidates: Transfer 50 dollars from checking to savings
Send $50 into my savings account
Move fifty dollars between my checking and savings accounts

groups.query: Require staff to verify their identity with a second factor at login.
candidates: Enable multi-factor authentication for employee accounts
Require MFA when users sign in
Configure an additional authentication factor for staff

groups.query: Remove the additional identity verification requirement for employee logins.
candidates: Disable multi-factor authentication for employee accounts
Remove the MFA requirement when users sign in
Turn off the additional authentication factor for staff

groups.query: Permit secure-shell connections to the production machine.
candidates: Allow SSH access to the production server
Enable secure shell login on the production host
Permit SSH connections to the production machine

groups.query: Prevent secure-shell connections from reaching the production host.
candidates: Block SSH access to the production server
Disable secure shell login on the production host
Deny SSH connections to the production machine

groups.query: Find a time when everyone on the team is available to meet.
candidates: Schedule a meeting at a time that works for the whole team
Find a shared availability window for a group meeting
Coordinate a calendar slot that suits all attendees

groups.query: Give me the important takeaways from this email conversation.
candidates: Summarize the key points in this email thread
Extract the main decisions from the email exchange
Provide a concise overview of this email conversation
